name: How do I maintain my new kitchen flooring?
description: Maintain new kitchen flooring with regular cleaning and prompt spill cleanup, following material-specific manufacturer guidelines.

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my new kitchen flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining your new kitchen flooring depends on the material. Generally, regular sweeping or vacuuming and prompt cleanup of spills are essential. For specific materials, follow manufacturer guidelines; for instance, some engineered hardwoods require specific cleaning solutions, while LVP can often be wet mopped with mild cleaners. Understanding the maintenance needs of your chosen flooring helps preserve its appearance and extend its lifespan.
